remarks:
Welcome to this charming five-bedroom ranch nestled on the escarpment, offering beautiful views and a private backyard retreat. Hickory hardwood floors flow throughout much of the home, adding warmth and character, while a wood-burning stove creates an inviting and cozy atmosphere.

The kitchen features charming wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and plenty of storage. The spacious primary suite offers a private en suite bathroom with dual vanity granite counters, a jetted tub, separate shower, and a large walk-in closet. Secondary full bath has been recently updated with dual vanity granite counter top and travertine tile floors and walk in shower.  Additional features include a cedar closet, partially finished basement, and abundant storage space. All mechanics have been recently updated for worry-free living.

Enjoy the outdoors from the newer maintenance-free deck overlooking the beautiful private yard. A flagstone patio with a waterfall creates a peaceful setting for relaxing or entertaining. The impressive 20’ x 11’ Amish-built shed provides exceptional additional storage and features a brand-new metal roof.

The attached three-car garage includes a 220-volt outlet for electric vehicle charging and hosts the perfect spot to store a recreational vehicle, sports car or boat. With five bedrooms, generous living and storage space, beautiful hardwood floors, and an exceptional outdoor setting, this home offers a wonderful combination of comfort, character, and privacy.
